name: stage_handtuned_g6dof_compliant_stand
description:
Joseph hand-tuned 2026-06-03 — first G6DOF compliant body that stands cleanly (stance similar to original hinge). All 3 joint types passively compliant (knee/hip2 stiffness 7.0, hip1 stiffness 8.0, damping 1.5 across the board).  Compensating motor authority: force_scale=2.0 × motor_authority_scale=1.5 = 3.0× nominal torque cap to drive joints against the springs.  joint_angular_limit_softness=1.0 = limits effectively free at the constraint level, which is why high motor force works without shake.  joint_angular_damping=1.5 = strong solver damping against high-freq joint chain ringing.

RESERVED PURPOSE: this is the G6DOF substrate handoff point for any future locomotion / Premotor-active-inference work that needs passive compliance.  Use as Stage 1 in a multi-stage curriculum.
